translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga wunyimbudulu mu nzila yikuendila ku nzo Yave.

content.text: A Yave, tebukila Davidi moyo
ayi ziphasi ziandi zioso kamona ;
wuzenga ndefi kuidi Yave
ayi wuvanga lukanu kuidi nkua lulendo wu Yakobi :
“Ndilendi kota ko mu nzo ama ;
voti kuenda va mbukꞌama.
Ndilendi vana ko meso mama minsua mu bua ku tulu ;
zindabu ziama mu laba,
nate ndimbakula buangu mu diambu di Yave,
buangu kivuanda mu diambu di nkua lulendo wu Yakobi.”
Tuwa tsangu beni ku Efalata, tuwila yawu mu zitsola zi Yali.
Bika tuenda ku buangu kiandi kioki keti vuanda ;
bika tubuongama va ntuala kima kioki keti tetika malu mandi.
Telama, a Yave, ayi kota ku buangu kiaku kivundila
ngeyo va kimosi ayi kesi yi zingolo ziaku.
Bika zinganga ziaku zi Nzambi zivuata busonga ;
bika banlongo baku bayimbila mu khini.
Mu diambu di Davidi kisadi kiaku,
kadi loza mutu aku wowo wuvinda mafuta.
Yave wuzenga ndefi kuidi Davidi ;
ndefi yikiedika yoyi kalendi viakisa ko :
“wumosi mu nkunꞌaku ndiela tula va kundu kiaku ki Kipfumu.
Enati bana baku bakebidi Nguizani ama
ayi zinzengolo ziozi ndiela ku balonga,
buna bana bawu bela vuanda va kundu kiaku ki kipfumu.”
Bila Yave wusobula Sioni ;
wuzola Sioni ngolo mu ba buangu kiandi kika fueti vuandanga :
“Vava vadi buangu kiama kivundila mu zithangu zioso.
Vava ndiela tula kundu kiama ki kipfumu bila ndizola vawu.
Ndiela kunsakumuna mu bima biwombo ;
minsukami miandi, ndiela kuba yukutisa mu bidia.
Ndiela vuika zinganga ziandi phulusu
ayi kadika thangu banlongo bandi bela yimbilanga mu khini.
Vava ndiela vanga phoka yi yunduka mu diambu Davidi
ayi kubika muinda mu diambu di mutu ama ndivinda mafuta.
Ndiela vuika bambeni ziandi tsoni
vayi budu ki kipfumu kiela lezamanga. Va mbata ntu andi.”
